result.summary: The main visible defect is the system gesture indicator overlapping the bottom navigation bar. No other clear visual defects were found.

issues.description: The system home/gesture indicator (gray pill) overlaps the bottom navigation bar, visually merging with the Search icon and making the tab bar look broken.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding/insets so the navigation bar sits above the system gesture indicator instead of being overlapped.
